class.name: FellowGasEmitter3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: a source of smoke, fuel and heat in its parent [FellowGasVolume3D].
class.description: A sphere, box or cylinder that adds [member smoke] and [member fuel] per second to the gas, heats it to [member temperature] (or adds heat per second), optionally with flickering value [member noise], and pulls the gas towards [member velocity]. Fire is fuel and heat: the fuel burns where the gas is hotter than the volume's ignition temperature. Must be a direct child of a [FellowGasVolume3D].

members.member: The box's size with [member shape] [constant SHAPE_BOX], in the emitter's space.
While on, the emitter adds to the gas every step; off, it adds nothing (the gas already released stays).

Fuel released per second where the emitter covers the gas, in the gas's units of fuel a cell. Fuel burns where the gas is above the volume's [member FellowGasVolume3D.ignition_temperature]: that is fire; with [member temperature] above it the emitter lights its own fuel.
The cylinder's height along the emitter's Y axis with [member shape] [constant SHAPE_CYLINDER] (its radius is [member radius]).
Flicker: how much a value noise drifting upwards through the emitter modulates what it releases (0: steady, 1: from nothing to twice as much).
The flicker noise's period in metres ([member noise]); smaller is finer.
The sphere's radius ([constant SHAPE_SPHERE]) or the cylinder's ([constant SHAPE_CYLINDER]).
The region the emitter covers: a sphere, a box or a vertical cylinder around its origin, soft at its edge.
Smoke density released per second where the emitter covers the gas.
With [constant TEMPERATURE_SET] the gas inside the emitter is kept at least this hot (kelvin); with [constant TEMPERATURE_ADD], the heat added per second.
How [member temperature] heats the gas: a floor ([constant TEMPERATURE_SET]) or a rate ([constant TEMPERATURE_ADD]).
The velocity the emitter pushes the gas towards, in its own space (turned with the node), in metres per second; see [member velocity_strength].
How strongly the gas inside the emitter is set to [member velocity] each step (0: not at all, 1: exactly).

constants.constant: A vertical cylinder of [member radius] and [member height].
The gas inside is at least [member temperature].
